items.title: We're Packing Up and Moving in Space Engineers 2 | Episode 15
items.description: Welcome back to our Space Engineers 2 Survival series! In this episode, we're hopping in the space engineers equivalent of a u-haul and moving to the area right next to the giant Verdure trade station! With the ability to fast travel to other stations, this is going to open up some great opportunities for us in the future. If you like the video, be sure to leave comments and hit that like button!
